rounds.text: Orbit Exports Ltd is profoundly mispriced relative to its peers, trading at a P/E multiple of 20.07x against a soaring sector benchmark of 46.3x [E6]. This massive valuation discount is entirely unjustified given the company's superior operational efficiency, highlighted by a robust Return on Assets of 8.75% that dramatically eclipses the sector benchmark of -4.12% [E8]. Furthermore, the equity is attractively valued on a price-to-book basis of 2.13x compared to the broader sector benchmark of 2.98x [E7], supported by a healthy underlying book value of ₹ 107 backing its ₹ 244 share price [E2]. Beneath this mispricing lies powerful structural momentum, demonstrated by a remarkable 82% compounded profit growth over the past 5 years [E19] alongside a confirmed multi-year sales uptrend [E63]. Conceded: the 10-year compounded profit growth sits at a modest 2% [E18], and the trailing twelve months reflect a minor earnings contraction of -3% [E21].
